## Invitations

The outreach activity recorded attendance of 222 people from 790 invited. This represents an attendance rate of 28.1 per cent. The figures provide a straightforward summary of engagement with the invitations issued during the reporting period. Attendance remained the central measure of participation, with the number attending recorded against the total number invited.

Practical arrangements were maintained where local conditions permitted. Van days were kept where roads allowed, supporting continued access to the outreach activity and helping maintain delivery across the area.

## Contact

Contact with invitees included text-message communication. A total of 663 invitations went with an SMS. A further 663 people received a reminder message. These communications supported the invitation process and provided an additional prompt for attendance.

The report was prepared by G. Evans.
